# Panel

`cinnabar:extension/panel@0.1.0`

An opt-in retained settings panel, rendered and hit-tested by the host.

**Grants:** `controls`.

## Types

<a id="type-event"></a>

### `event`

One numeric control event routed to its owning mod by control ID.

```wit
record event {
    id: string,
    value: f32,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `value` | `f32` |  |

<a id="type-panel-layout"></a>

### `panel-layout`

Where this mod's panel lies over the HUD root as last laid out: the panel root's
`width` and `height` in panel units, `scale`, the HUD GUI units one panel unit spans,
which follows the GUI scale and a `reference_size` fitted to a small window, and
`offset`, the panel root's top left in HUD GUI units from the HUD root's top left. The
pointer of `input.read-controls` at `p` lies at `(p - offset) / scale` in panel units.

```wit
record panel-layout {
    width: f32,
    height: f32,
    scale: f32,
    offset: tuple<f32, f32>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `f32` |  |
| `height` | `f32` |  |
| `scale` | `f32` |  |
| `offset` | `tuple<f32, f32>` |  |

## Functions

<a id="open"></a>

### `open`

```wit
open: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

Opens this instance's panel on successful callback return. Requires controls
authority and retained or pending panel content. Repeated opens keep it open.
The latest opener owns input and closes other owners. Opening keys belong to the mod.

<a id="close"></a>

### `close`

```wit
close: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

Closes this instance's panel on successful callback return. Requires controls authority.
Repeated closes keep it closed; content remains available for a later open.

<a id="toggle"></a>

### `toggle`

```wit
toggle: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

Flips this instance's requested visibility, including earlier requests in this callback.
Uses the same authority, content and successful-return rules as open and close.

<a id="set-content"></a>

### `set-content`

```wit
set-content: func(json: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Bounded panel JSON; empty text removes the panel and releases its input. A
`cinnabar_hud_control` node draws a named control of this mod's HUD surface, centred:
its laid-out box fitted to the node, or at `scale` times its HUD size, or with `fit`,
its painted ink filling that fraction of the node, at most `max_scale` times its HUD
size.

<a id="update-content"></a>

### `update-content`

```wit
update-content: func(json: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Applies a bounded sparse control patch and registered surface route atomically.
A route change keeps the offset of each scroll view the new surface shares by layout key, clamped to its content.
Omitting controls preserves them; bindings, when present, replace custom scalars.
The JSON record optionally accepts collection_reveal: {collection: string, item: u32}.
The item is its immutable published index, resolved through the accepted collection_order.
Each request is consumed once; a filtered-out item is ignored.
Optional show_gameplay_hud: bool changes whether the gameplay HUD and mods' HUD
surfaces stay drawn under the open panel; it lasts until changed again or until
set-content replaces the panel.

<a id="read-layout"></a>

### `read-layout`

```wit
read-layout: func() -> option<panel-layout>;
```

Requires controls authority; none without it and while this mod's panel is not open.

Types: [`panel-layout`](panel.md#type-panel-layout).
